title: Staffage cast level of detail
description: Render detail levels of a cast. A level samples the same analytical state at canonical times and draws a subset of the same authored shapes; it never changes units, origin, anchors, scenario or the clock of the cast.

frames.description: Sampling of the canonical clock. outputFpsFraction: the level samples at most this fraction of the output frame rate of the job (null: the cast's own rate). maxFrames: the largest number of samples. phase: the fraction of the duration a single sample is taken at.

roles.description: The shape roles that are drawn; paper extents still reach every shape.

patterns.description: Colour-independent hatch cues of the analytic views.

transportDensity.description: The fraction of the parcels and pathlines drawn: every ceil(1 / density)-th, deterministic by emission index.

strokeMin.description: The thinnest stroke the Manim bridge draws, in Manim stroke-width units.
